BOT-001.name: Telegram Bot Token Leak
BOT-001.description: Telegram bot token found in source code or configuration files
BOT-001.remediation: Rotate token via @BotFather. Store in environment variables or secret manager.

BOT-002.name: Webhook Without Secret Verification
BOT-002.description: Webhook endpoint does not verify the secret token header
BOT-002.remediation: Set secret_token in set_webhook and verify X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header.

BOT-003.name: Webhook Over HTTP
BOT-003.description: Webhook URL uses HTTP instead of HTTPS
BOT-003.remediation: Configure HTTPS with valid TLS certificates for webhook endpoint.

BOT-004.name: Bot eval/exec RCE
BOT-004.description: Use of eval() or exec() with potentially user-controlled data
BOT-004.remediation: Never eval/exec untrusted data. Use parsers and whitelists.

BOT-005.name: Bot Command Injection
BOT-005.description: Subprocess call with shell=True allows command injection
BOT-005.remediation: Use argument lists for subprocess calls. Never use shell=True.

BOT-006.name: No Rate Limiting
BOT-006.description: Bot has no rate limiting — susceptible to flood and spam
BOT-006.remediation: Implement per-user and global rate limiting middleware.

BOT-007.name: Insecure File Upload
BOT-007.description: File upload/download without type/size validation or malware scan
BOT-007.remediation: Whitelist MIME types, enforce size limits, save outside webroot, scan for malware.

BOT-008.name: Secret Leakage in Logs
BOT-008.description: Tokens or secrets may be logged in plain text
BOT-008.remediation: Never log secrets. Redact sensitive fields before logging.

BOT-009.name: Container Runs as Root
BOT-009.description: Bot container runs as root — privilege escalation risk
BOT-009.remediation: Add USER directive with non-root user. Drop all capabilities.

BOT-010.name: Insecure Deserialization
BOT-010.description: Unsafe pickle or yaml.load in bot code
BOT-010.remediation: Use yaml.safe_load() and json.loads(). Never unpickle untrusted data.

BOT-011.name: No IP Allowlist for Webhook
BOT-011.description: Webhook accepts requests from any IP without restriction
BOT-011.remediation: Restrict webhook to Telegram IP ranges (149.154.160.0/20, 91.108.4.0/22).

BOT-012.name: Hardcoded Webhook Secret
BOT-012.remediation: Move to .env (not in VCS) or secret manager.
